# Computer Vision Engineering

> Build vision systems that are measured by condition, fitted to a roadside processor and released with evidence. SDAIA Academy course AE-309, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 23,717 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Visual data first](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day1.md): Before any model: how the field breaks a classifier, what a label means, who drew it, and which frames may share a split; sessions: How vision systems fail in the field, Annotation guidelines and agreement, Leakage by site and near-duplicates, Augmentation and what it assumes; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day1.html; about 5,440 tokens
- [Day 2: Backbones and transfer](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day2.md): Two families of pretrained backbone, how much of one to train, the zero-shot floor, and what a licence lets the department deploy; sessions: Convolutional networks and vision transformers, How much to fine-tune, Zero-shot baselines, Licences of open-weight backbones; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day2.html; about 5,606 tokens
- [Day 3: Detect, segment and track](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day3.md): A pothole detector and what its number means, its errors by type, a crack segmenter against a simple baseline, and vehicles counted across a line; sessions: Detection and its metrics, Detector error analysis, Segmenting cracks, Tracking and counting; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day3.html; about 5,157 tokens
- [Day 4: Fit the budget and release](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day4.md): Export, the latency and size budget of the roadside unit, tests under rain, glare, night and a moved camera, privacy before storage, and the release decision; sessions: Export to an interchange format, Resolution and precision against latency, Corruption and shift tests, Privacy and monitoring in the field; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/day4.html; about 5,739 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a service that meets its budget, defended on a failure](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/capstone.md): An inspection or counting service for Al-Manar with its field-conditions test set, model card and release memo; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/slides/capstone.html; about 1,171 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Errors by condition](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D1_1_errors_by_condition.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Agree on a new class](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D1_2_annotation_agreement.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Split by road segment](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D1_3_split_by_segment.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Augment without changing labels](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D1_4_augmentation.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Two backbones by slice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D2_1_two_backbones.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Probe or fine-tune](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D2_2_probe_or_finetune.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: The zero-shot floor](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D2_3_zero_shot_floor.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Which backbone may ship](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D2_4_backbone_licences.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Train and score a detector](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D3_1_detector_ap.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Sort fifty errors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D3_2_error_analysis.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Segment cracks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D3_3_segment_cracks.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Track and count](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D3_4_track_count.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Export and check parity](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D4_1_export_parity.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Fit the latency budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D4_2_latency_budget.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Field-condition tests](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D4_3_field_tests.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Blur, monitor, choose](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-309/labs/D4_4_privacy_monitoring.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
